node.title: Arbitraje de recursos
node.summary: Resolve competing proposals before committing shared capacity.

relations: A shared-resource intent layer could be tested for industrial deployment without importing financial allocation rules unchanged.
No trasladar automáticamente netting financiero ni una política de venta-compra al inventario industrial. Calidad, titularidad y prioridad contractual requieren reglas propias.
A cross-operator assignment should carry the context and acceptance conditions that allow each responsible operator to authorize its own action.
Es una extensión de diseño que debe contrastarse con contratos e interfaces reales; no una función general ya validada.
Batch coordination and operational buffers can be compared as ways of timing a coupled intervention, provided urgent obligations and response windows remain explicit.
No se propone acumular tensión deliberadamente ni trasladar sin adaptación una política de transporte a otro dominio.
The later cartography distinguishes semantic compatibility from shared-resource dependence, a useful retrospective lens on xSeil’s state-dependent allocation.
xSeil no se convierte por esta comparación en una implementación distribuida de MSCA.
The constructed smart-city scenario can inform a new shared-capacity test inspired by Tuxpan, without claiming that its fictional failure occurred in the historical service.
Analogía posterior y escenario construido de 2026; no ensayo urbano ni episodio observado del caso.
The historical allocation mechanism can inspire a later cartographic treatment of shared dependencies without being relabeled as an MSCA deployment.
Se propone una comparación posterior, no una prueba de influencia causal documentada para cada decisión de arquitectura.
A constructed shared-capacity scenario could test whether locally valid mobility decisions remain coherent at the declared system boundary.
No se afirma ejecución del ensayo, producción implantada o fallo observado de Mobility OS.
The cartography overlay adds an encounter gate to the two-provider model; its four observers and geometric score are separate from physical resources and realized mission output.
El enlace es interno a una rama abierta; no demuestra por sí mismo generalización a N proveedores ni a redes reales.
A certificate sufficient for one request need not remain sufficient when simultaneous requests consume the same underlying capacity.
El resultado es de un árbol finito construido; no establece que toda composición pierda información o falle materialmente.
